world.title: 'Politicisation of energy flows harmful': Jaishankar calls for diversified supply chains at G20
world.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar emphasized the need to minimize political interference in energy markets during the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta. He advocated for diversified global supply chains to enhance energy security and reduce vulnerabilities. Jaishankar's remarks highlighted the importance of a stable energy flow, free from political influences, to support global economic resilience.

world.title: Estimated 320,000 take to the streets nationwide
world.summary: Protests in France continued for a third weekend, with an estimated 320,000 people demonstrating against rising living costs and poor school conditions. Clashes occurred between protesters and police in several cities on Saturday. The ongoing unrest reflects widespread dissatisfaction among citizens regarding economic issues and educational environments, prompting significant public mobilization across the country.

world.title: Lula da Silva | The Pele of Brazil’s politics
world.summary: Lula da Silva, a prominent figure in Brazil's politics, has significantly influenced the Workers' Party and the nation's political landscape, steering it away from Bolsonarismo. His rise is marked by resilience and strategic maneuvering, culminating in a presidential runoff. Flávio Bolsonaro's derogatory remarks during a debate highlight ongoing political tensions as Brazil approaches a pivotal electoral moment.

business.title: OPEC+ agrees in principle to keep oil output targets steady in December, sources say
business.summary: OPEC+ oil-producing countries have agreed in principle to maintain their December oil output targets during a meeting on Sunday, according to three sources familiar with the discussions. This decision aligns with expectations that no further adjustments to output policy will occur until next year. The agreement reflects a consensus among member nations regarding current production levels.

business.title: Gold, Silver rates crash: What happened with precious metal rates? What didn't go in favour and brought them down?
business.summary: Gold and silver prices significantly decreased on Friday, with MCX gold dropping ₹4,347 per 10 grams and silver declining ₹10,577 per kg. Various factors contributed to this decline, impacting market dynamics and investor sentiment. The sharp fall in precious metal rates reflects broader economic conditions and market trends, leading to a reevaluation of asset values among investors.

business.title: Binance says it has covered 90% of losses from $6.3 billion hack so far
business.summary: Crypto exchange Binance announced on Saturday that it has successfully replaced 90% of the $6.3 billion lost in a recent hack. The recovery was achieved by utilizing company funds to purchase new tokens. The remaining 10% of the stolen amount consists of tokens that are still unaccounted for, as Binance continues its efforts to address the incident.

technology.title: GTA 6 features 600,000 animations as Rockstar takes NPC realism to another level: Report
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set for release on November 19, 2026, after multiple delays. Rockstar collaborated with a Los Angeles team to enhance character realism, resulting in 600,000 unique animations for non-playable characters (NPCs). This extensive production effort aims to provide distinct identities for each character, contributing to a more immersive gaming experience.

technology.title: Samsung now mocks Apple iPhone Duo with crackgate memes too
technology.summary: Samsung is capitalizing on Apple's recent issues with the iPhone Duo, particularly the problems related to broken hinges and damaged displays. The South Korean company's marketing teams are using memes to mock Apple’s misfortunes, continuing a long-standing tradition of rivalry. Samsung hopes to avoid any major scandals like the Galaxy Note 7 incident in the future.

technology.title: Why the Sony A7R VI is my Camera of the Year for 2026 — it has speed, quality and ruggedness in spades, and is basically all the camera you'll ever need
technology.summary: The Sony A7R VI has been named Camera of the Year for 2026, praised for its speed, quality, and ruggedness. Despite challenges such as component shortages and price increases affecting the camera industry, the A7R VI stands out among fewer new releases, offering exceptional performance and features, making it a highly regarded choice for photographers.

sports.title: Glenn Phillips on the brink of breaking world record in last T20I vs India
sports.summary: Glenn Phillips is poised to break a world record in the fifth and final T20I against India on November 1. He has been a crucial player for New Zealand, notably celebrating a century during the recent T20 match in Auckland. His performance in this upcoming game could solidify his place in cricket history, depending on his achievements.

sports.title: India vs Bangladesh Live Streaming: When And Where To Watch Hong Kong Sixes 2026 Match Live In India
sports.summary: India will compete against Bangladesh in the 11th/12th-place play-off of the Hong Kong Sixes 2026 on November 1. The match, led by Krunal Pandya for India, follows both teams' defeats in the Bowl semi-finals. Fans can check the match time, venue, and details for live telecast and streaming options in India for this event.

sports.title: Real, Mbappe have moved on from China controversy, says Mourinho
sports.summary: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho stated that the club and Kylian Mbappe have moved past the controversy surrounding Mbappe's comments about former Chinese leader Mao Zedong. Mourinho emphasized that both parties responded appropriately by issuing apologies. The incident underscores the potential risks athletes and brands face in the lucrative but sensitive Chinese market.

health.title: Obesity on the rise: A global wake-up call
health.summary: Obesity is increasingly recognized as a significant global health issue, impacting individuals across all age groups. It extends beyond personal lifestyle choices, contributing to rising healthcare costs and system strain. Factors such as unhealthy food environments and sedentary lifestyles are exacerbating the situation. Addressing obesity requires comprehensive strategies to improve public health and reduce its prevalence worldwide.

health.title: Indian Biotech Startup Claims To Offer Personalised Cancer Vaccines
health.summary: Hyderabad-based biotech startup PopVax has launched RNA Foundry, a facility dedicated to producing personalized mRNA cancer vaccines. Established in 2021, PopVax aims to revolutionize cancer treatment in India by developing tailored vaccines for individual patients. This initiative highlights advancements in biotechnology and the potential for customized medical solutions in the fight against cancer.

health.title: Manipal Hospitals Urges Early Stroke Detection Through BE FAST Approach
health.summary: Manipal Hospitals organized a stroke awareness program in Kolkata on October 29, 2026, to commemorate World Stroke Day. The event emphasized the BE FAST approach for early stroke detection, promoting awareness of symptoms and the importance of timely medical intervention. The initiative aims to enhance stroke prevention efforts and encourage individuals to seek immediate care when symptoms arise.

science.title: NASA's Lucy Breaks Ground in Space Exploration by Entering Jupiter's Trojan Asteroids
science.summary: NASA's Lucy spacecraft has made history as the first to enter Jupiter's Trojan asteroid region, completing a journey of over 2.2 billion miles in five years. This groundbreaking mission aims to reveal insights about the early Solar System by studying the two large groups of asteroids that share Jupiter's orbital path around the Sun.

science.title: Scientists discover how a common gut bacterium can trigger colon cancer: Study
science.summary: Scientists at Johns Hopkins have identified a significant link between a common gut bacterium and colorectal cancer, addressing a long-standing mystery in cancer research. This discovery may enhance understanding of the mechanisms behind colon cancer development, potentially leading to improved prevention and treatment strategies. The study highlights the importance of gut microbiota in influencing cancer risk and progression.
